P.name: Rage Gene
P.title: Template:Data Gnar/Rage Gene
P.wikitext: {{{{{1|Ability data}}}|Rage Gene|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}} |champion = Gnar |skill = I |icon = Rage Gene.png |blurbicon = Rage Gene.png |blurb = {{sbc|Innate - Rage Gene:}} {{ci|Gnar|Mini Gnar}} generates ''Rage'' while fighting. At maximum ''Rage'', his next {{tip|ability}} will be ''{{cis|Mega Gnar}}'' as he transforms, losing ''Mini Gnar's'' passive effects in exchange for increased stats and new abilities. |blurb2 = ''Mega Gnar'' form lasts for some time before reverting to ''Mini Gnar'', afterwards he cannot generate ''Rage'' for some time. |description = {{sbc|Innate - Rage Gene:}} {{ci|Gnar|Mini Gnar}} generates {{pp|4;7;11|1 to 11}} ''{{ai|Rage Gene|Gnar|Rage}}'' over 2 seconds upon dealing or receiving damage, up to 100. Against non-champions, {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and ''{{ai|Boomerang Throw|Gnar}}'' instantly generate{{ft|{{pp|4*0.125;7*0.125;11*0.125|1 to 11|round=false}} ''Rage''.|{{fd|12.5%}} of the amount.}} Against champions, ''{{ai|Boomerang Throw|Gnar}}'' instantly generates{{ft|{{pp|4*0.25;7*0.25;11*0.25|1 to 11|round=false}} ''Rage'',|25% of the amount,}}and basic attacks ''on-hit'' instantly generate{{ft|{{pp|4*0.5;7*0.5;11*0.5|1 to 11|round=false}}.|50% of the amount.}}''{{ai|Boomerang Throw|Gnar}}'' can only generate ''Rage'' once per cast, and grants ''Rage'' based on the first enemy hit. '''Gnar's''' ''Rage'' decays after being [[combat status|out of combat]] for 13 seconds. |icon2 = Rage Gene 2.png |description2 = At maximum ''Rage'', '''Gnar's''' {{tip|abilities}} switch to {{cis|Mega Gnar}} abilities, for 4 seconds and until transforming back to his ''Mini Gnar'' form, with the exception of ''{{ai|Hop and Crunch|Gnar|Hop}}'', which switches after the transformation. Casting any of them during this time also causes '''Gnar''' to transform into {{ci|Mega Gnar}} instantly, else he will transform automatically after the 4 seconds have elapsed. |description3 = '''Gnar's''' {{ci|Mega Gnar|Mega}} form lasts for 15 seconds, with his ''Rage'' bar depleting as an indication of remaining time. ''Rage cannot be generated while in this form.'' Afterwards, '''Gnar''' returns to {{ci|Gnar|Mini Gnar}}, retaining his {{sti|health|{{as|'''current''' percentage health}}}} and becoming too [[File:Rage Gene 4.png|20px]] ''tired'' to generate ''Rage'' for 15 seconds. |description4 = '''Gnar''' gains different stat bonuses based on whether he is in ''{{ai|Mini Gnar|Gnar|Mini}}'' or ''{{ai|Mega Gnar|Gnar|Mega}}'' form. Both of '''Gnar's''' forms share their ability cooldowns. |targeting = Passive |affects = Self |damagetype = |spellshield = |spelleffects = |projectile = |grounded = |knockdown = |notes = * The ''Rage'' generated upon dealing or receiving damage occurs over 2 seconds with 4 ticks every {{fd|0.5}} seconds. It also does not stack but instead refreshes with subsequent applications (of dealing or receiving damage). * In-game, the value on the ''Rage'' bar always displays rounded down to the nearest integer. * {{cis|Mega Gnar}} gained health is not affected by {{tip|healing}} modifiers such as {{tip|Grievous Wounds}} and those from [[item]]s and [[rune]]s. * When returning to {{ci|Gnar|Mini Gnar}}, '''Gnar''' will only retain his current health percentage, not current health total. * '''Gnar's''' abilities share {{sti|cooldowns}} across forms. * The ''Rage'' bar is '''white''' when under 60 range, '''yellow''' when equal to or above 60 rage, and '''red''' at 100 rage. * If '''Gnar''' transforms into {{ci|Mega Gnar}} while on enemy's sight and later goes back to {{ai|Mini Gnar|Gnar|Mini}} while on the fog of war, enemies will see {{cis|Mega Gnar}} icon both in the scoreboard and minimap, even if they regain vision of '''Gnar'''. This will stay this way until '''Gnar's''' {{ci|Mega Gnar|Mega}} form ends while on enemy's sight.{{bug}} |flavorsound = {{sm2|Gnar_Original_Transform_2.ogg}} ''"GNAR!"'' }}

|damagetype   = Magic
|spellshield  = False

|parry        = True

}}

E.name: Hop
E.title: Template:Data Gnar/Hop
E.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Hop|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Gnar
|skill        = E
|icon         = Hop.png
|icon3        = Hop and Crunch.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Gnar|Mini Gnar}} {{tip|dash|leaps}} to the target location and bounces off of any unit he lands on, {{tip|dash|leaping}} forth again without a bounce. He also gains {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for a few seconds.
|blurb2       = Bouncing off an enemy deals {{as|physical damage}} to them and {{tip|slows}} them.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Gnar''' {{tip|dash|leaps}} to the target location, then gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 6 seconds.
|leveling     = {{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|40 to 60}}%}}
|description2 = If '''Gnar''' lands on a unit he will {{tip|dash|bounce}} 500 units further in the same direction. Landing on an enemy deals them {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 80% for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.
|leveling2    = {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|50 to 190}} {{as|(+ 6% '''maximum''' health)}}}}
|description3 = If ''Hop'' is used to transform, it will not grant {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}. Instead, after {{tip|dash|bouncing}} '''Gnar''' will send out a shockwave as per ''{{ai|Crunch|Gnar}}'' {{tt|where he lands|Only after bouncing. This is not intended. See details section.}}.
|description4 = '''Gnar''' will not bounce if he is {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} during the first leap.
|description5 = ''{{ai|Boomerang Throw|Gnar}} can be cast during the dash.''
|cooldown     = {{ap|22 to 12}}
|target range = {{tt|475|Maximum dash distance}}
|effect radius= {{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|150|Bounce-off radius, center-to-edge}} 
|targeting    = Location
|cast time    = none
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Physical
|spellshield  = True
|spelleffects = Single target
|projectile   = 
|grounded     = True
|knockdown    = True
|outofrange   = cast at max
|notes        = 
* ''Hop'' has no minimum dash range.
* ''Hop'' does not allow '''Gnar''' to bounce off wards.
* If '''Gnar''' generates Rage to maximum during ''Hop'', he may cast {{ai|Boulder Toss|Gnar}}, {{ai|Wallop|Gnar}}, or {{ai|GNAR!|Gnar}} during the bounce.
* If ''Hop'' generates ''Rage'' to maximum after '''Gnar''' bounces off an enemy, he may cast {{ai|GNAR!|Gnar}}, and then {{ai|Boulder Toss|Gnar}} or {{ai|Wallop|Gnar}} before he lands.{{bug}}
* {{tip|Sleep}} does not count for preventing the bounce.{{bug}}
* If circumstances allow it, ''Crunch's'' shockwave from using it to transform can hit the target '''Gnar''' bounced off of.
* If ''Hop'' is used to transform, the area of effect is missing at the first landing location, whether he bounces off a target or not.{{bug}}
** This interaction broke in [[V9.13]].
}}

|inner radius = {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 200

|cast time    = none
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Physical
|spellshield  = True
|spelleffects = Area of effect
|projectile   = 
|grounded     = True
|knockdown    = True
|outofrange   = cast at max
|notes        =

* If circumstances allow it, ''Crunch's'' shockwave from using it to transform can hit the target '''Gnar''' bounced off of.
}}
